gaps.explanation: Statement of Receipts, Disbursements, and Changes in Net Position - Cash Basis - Proprietary Fund p6 prints one 'Enterprise Fund' column; there is no enterprise budget schedule in the trim, so detail has no business-type line. JSON statement receipts 43,428 = Total operating revenues collected 43,428 + total non-operating receipts 0. Adds (rows as in the JSON statement receipts): Charges for services: Sewer 21,142 + Water 22,286; non-operating Licenses, fees, and permits 250 + Miscellaneous (250). Sum 21,142 + 22,286 + 250 - 250 = 43,428 = statement.
